name: University of Oxford
typicalOffer: A*AA, including Mathematics and Physics; the A* must be in Mathematics, Physics or Further Mathematics
notes: 4-year MPhys integrated Masters; Maths and Physics A-levels required; entrance test and interview; strong theoretical and experimental groups

name: University of Cambridge
typicalOffer: A*A*A, Mathematics plus 2 other science or mathematics subjects (Biology, Chemistry, Physics, and for A level only Further Mathematics); some Colleges/first-year options need specific sciences
notes: Natural Sciences (Physical) — students specialise in Physics from Year 2; NSAA test required; access to Cavendish Laboratory

name: University of St Andrews
typicalOffer: AAA, including A in both Mathematics and Physics
notes: 4-year MPhys; consistently top-ranked UK physics department; strong photonics and astrophysics research; Scottish 4-year Honours structure

name: Imperial College London
typicalOffer: A*A*A, A* in Mathematics; A* in Physics; A in another subject (Further Mathematics recommended but not essential)
notes: 4-year MPhys; strong links to CERN and ESA; high-energy physics and quantum research centre at Blackett Laboratory

name: Durham University
typicalOffer: A*A*A, including Physics and Mathematics; science A levels with a practical component require the practical to be passed
notes: 4-year MPhys; Institute for Particle Physics Phenomenology on campus; strong astrophysics group; Ogden Centre for Fundamental Physics

name: University of Edinburgh
typicalOffer: AAA-ABB, including Mathematics at A and Physics at B
notes: 4-year MPhys; Higgs Centre for Theoretical Physics; strong particle physics and condensed matter; Scottish 4-year structure

name: University of Warwick
typicalOffer: A*AA, including A in Mathematics (or Further Mathematics) and Physics
notes: 4-year MPhys; strong condensed matter and HEP groups; Warwick HEP group at CERN; excellent tech industry links

name: University of Bristol
typicalOffer: A*AA, including A*A (in any order) in Mathematics and Physics
notes: 4-year MPhys; Bristol Quantum Information Institute; quantum photonics research centre; strong industry placement programme

name: University College London
typicalOffer: A*AA, A*A in Mathematics and Physics (any order)
notes: 4-year MPhys; Mullard Space Science Laboratory; strong cosmology and astrophysics; London HEP group

name: University of Southampton
typicalOffer: A*AA-AAA, including physics (minimum grade A) and either mathematics or further mathematics (minimum grade A)
notes: 4-year MPhys; world-leading optoelectronics and photonics group; strong semiconductor physics and quantum photonics

name: University of Bath
typicalOffer: A*AA, including Mathematics and Physics, with A* in Mathematics or Physics (or Further Mathematics)
notes: 4-year MPhys with optional placement; excellent graduate employment; strong applied physics and photonics; Bath is UK's top placement university

name: University of Manchester
typicalOffer: A*A*A, including A* in Physics and A* in Mathematics or Further Mathematics
notes: 4-year MPhys; birthplace of the electron and graphene (Nobel 2010); Jodrell Bank Observatory partnership for astrophysics

name: University of York
typicalOffer: AAA, including Physics and Mathematics
notes: 4-year MPhys; York Centre for Quantum Technologies; strong nuclear and plasma physics; National Physical Laboratory links

name: University of Nottingham
typicalOffer: AAA, Including AA in A level maths and physics
notes: 4-year MPhys; Sir Peter Mansfield Imaging Centre (MRI inventor); strong nanoscience and quantum information research

name: University of Exeter
typicalOffer: AAA-ABB, including A in Mathematics and B in Physics, or B in Mathematics and A in Physics (Maths, Pure Maths or Further Maths accepted)
notes: 4-year MPhys; strong computational and climate physics; links to Met Office HQ in Exeter; renewable energy physics research

name: University of Birmingham
typicalOffer: A*AA or AAAA, including A-level Mathematics and Physics at grades A*A (or AA as part of the four A-level offer)
notes: 4-year MPhys; key gravitational wave group (LIGO partner); particle physics at LHC; Birmingham Gravitational Wave group

name: University of Leeds
typicalOffer: AAA, including Physics and Mathematics; pass in practical science element where an A-level science is taken
notes: 4-year MPhys; Bragg Centre for Materials Research; strong condensed matter and biophysics; one of UK's largest physics intakes

name: King's College London
typicalOffer: AAA, including grade A in Mathematics and Physics
notes: 4-year MPhys; central London location; strong medical physics and photonics; links to major tech and finance employers

name: Cardiff University
typicalOffer: AAA-ABB, including grade B in Maths and Physics (Maths without Physics considered, normally with grade A in Maths); science practical must be passed
notes: 4-year MPhys; Cardiff is a key LIGO/Virgo gravitational wave node; compound semiconductor research; strong astrophysics group

name: University of Sheffield
typicalOffer: AAA, including Maths and Physics + pass in the practical element of any science A Levels taken
notes: 4-year MPhys; Sheffield Centre for Advanced Magnetic Materials; strong materials physics and condensed matter research

name: Newcastle University
typicalOffer: AAB, including Mathematics and Physics (or ABB with Maths and Physics if the third A level is from Further Maths, Biology, Chemistry, English Literature, Geography, History, Modern/Classical Languages, or grade 2 in any STEP paper); practical pass required for science A levels
notes: 4-year MPhys; strong links to nuclear and energy sector; photovoltaics and fusion energy research; proximity to UKAEA Culham

name: University of Glasgow
typicalOffer: AAB, A-level Mathematics and A-level Physics
notes: 4-year MPhys; key LIGO gravitational wave detection role; strong astrophysics and quantum computing; Scottish 4-year Honours

name: University of Leicester
typicalOffer: ABB, including Physics and Maths
notes: 4-year MPhys; Space Research Centre — birthplace of X-ray astronomy; strong planetary science and space instrumentation

name: University of Liverpool
typicalOffer: ABB, including Physics and Mathematics at A level
notes: 4-year MPhys; Cockcroft Institute of Accelerator Science; particle physics group at LHC; strong laser and plasma physics

name: University of Sussex
typicalOffer: ABB, A-levels must include Mathematics grade B; Physics A-level desirable but not required
notes: 4-year MPhys; Sussex Centre for Quantum Technologies; historically strong theoretical physics — Abdus Salam (Nobel 1979) worked here
